Off the Books: Backpacks 1.8.0

WHAT IT DOES
You upgrade your backpacks by dropping materials on them: more rows, more columns,
more compartments (pages), side bag slots and a toolbox slot. The mod adds two
backpacks of its own, Scavenger's Pack and Hauler's Pack, gives backpacks more ways to
turn up, and adds two starting perks. It needs no other mod.

HOW TO USE IT
Drop a material on a closed backpack that is yours.
- A single item takes one step of one upgrade. It uses what the step needs, from the
  item you dropped and from the same material inside the backpack.
- A stack takes every step it covers, one after the other, and the rest stays a stack.
  This holds for a whole stack dragged from inside the backpack as well. Switch it off
  with "A dropped stack upgrades as far as it reaches" to get one step per drop.
- Several selected items take one step.
The backpack's tooltip shows what it has and what the next step needs. Right-click a
backpack and choose Configure for the full list. The button "Use from backpack" there
takes the next step from the material that lies in the backpack.
A material goes to the first upgrade that still needs it, in this order: rows, width,
compartments, stack size, side bag slots, toolbox slot.

To move an item to another compartment, hold it over that compartment's tab for 0.35
seconds. Let it go on the tab, or let a group of selected items go there, and the items
move into that compartment. This works wherever the backpack is shown, including in a
slot, and on every tab strip, storage bays included. Items that do not fit stay where
they were.

THE UPGRADES
- Rows: Kotton Fabric. Each row costs one more than the last. Backpack (Basic),
  Backpack (Large) and the two new packs have no row upgrades.
- Width: Kotton Fabric for the first columns of Backpack (Basic), Backpack (Large),
  Scavenger's Pack and Hauler's Pack, then 3D Printing Filament. The smaller backpacks
  use 3D Printing Filament throughout. Backpack (Basic) grows to 12x9 and Backpack
  (Large) to 15x9.
- Compartments: more pages in the same backpack. Drop a smaller, empty bag on it and
  the bag is used up.
  Kid's Backpack, Kid's Backpack (Large) and Backpack (Small) take a Fanny Pack.
  Backpack (Basic) takes a Satchel (Small), then a Backpack (Small).
  Backpack (Large) takes a Backpack (Small), then a Backpack (Basic), then a Module Bay
  Expansion Kit and a Storage Bay Expansion Kit.
  Scavenger's Pack follows Backpack (Basic), Hauler's Pack follows Backpack (Large).
  To keep a bag inside a backpack instead, open the backpack and drag it in.
- Stack size, four steps: 2 Wire; 2 Wire and 1 Metal Screws; 3 Wire and 2 Metal
  Screws; 1 Metal Ingot and 2 Metal Screws. The step sets the stack size a stacking
  mod may use inside the backpack. Without such a mod it has no effect and still costs
  the materials.
- Side bag slots: 2 Wire and 1 Metal Screws for the first slot of Kid's Backpack, Kid's
  Backpack (Large), Backpack (Small), Backpack (Basic) and Scavenger's Pack. A Module Bay
  Expansion Kit pays for each other slot. A slot holds one small bag (Fanny Pack,
  Satchel (Small), Kid's Backpack, Kid's Backpack (Large) or Backpack (Small)), which
  you can take out again. A side bag slot of the Hauler's Pack also takes a Backpack
  (Basic).
- Toolbox slot (Backpack (Basic) and larger): 1 Metal Ingot and 2 Scrap Metal.
The side bag slots and the toolbox slot share a panel called ATTACHED.

TWO NEW BACKPACKS
Scavenger's Pack: mid-sized, 6x9 to start with, grows to 16x9. It takes 4x5 squares.
Hauler's Pack: large, 7x11 to start with, grows to 17x11. It takes 4x6 squares.
They take every upgrade that fits their size and have pictures of their own.

WHERE BACKPACKS TURN UP
Dr. Jackson, the Dumping Grounds and scavenger sellers bring backpacks more often than
the game does, and one scavenger seller in a hundred brings a worn toolbox. Each chance
is a setting: 100 is the normal scale, and each description shows the current chances.

TWO STARTING PERKS
Seasoned Courier (1 point): start with a Scavenger's Pack that already has an extra
column, a second compartment, stack size 2 and a toolbox slot.
Quartermaster's Issue (3 points): start with a fully upgraded Hauler's Pack.
Neither gives anything while "Backpack upgrades" is switched off.

SETTINGS
All settings are in the Mods list and in Options, under Off the Books: Backpacks. The
source settings are under Off the Books: Backpacks: Backpack sources.
- Backpack upgrades: allows new upgrade steps. The seven settings that follow switch
  off one upgrade or the Configure view each: Backpack rows, Backpack width, Backpack
  compartments, Backpack stack size, Backpack side bag slots, Backpack toolbox slot,
  Backpack upgrades view. Backpacks keep what they already have.
- A dropped stack upgrades as far as it reaches: one step per drop when off.
- Compartment tabs take dragged items: the tab hover and drop described above.
- Backpacks can carry empty bags: lets an owned bag that is empty in every
  compartment, side bag slot and toolbox slot go inside a backpack.
- Scavenger's Pack and Hauler's Pack: allows their pictures, upgrades and sources.
- Extra backpack sources: allows the extra chances. The three sliders (Dr. Jackson,
  Dumping Grounds, Scavenger sellers: backpack chances, scale) set each source from 0
  to 300. "Worn toolbox from scavenger sellers" switches the toolbox chance.
- Offer Seasoned Courier in a new game, Offer Quartermaster's Issue in a new game:
  each needs a restart to take effect.
- Before removing this mod: list what to move. See the section on removal.
The game's debug menu has entries under "Backpacks" that put a fully upgraded backpack
of each kind into the shop.

WHAT IT CHANGES IN A SAVE
Upgrades, compartments and slots are stored on the backpack in your save. Scavenger's
Pack and Hauler's Pack are items of the mod.

BEFORE YOU REMOVE THIS MOD
Without the mod the game builds every backpack at its own size. What lies in extra
rows, columns, compartments, side bag slots and toolbox slots is dropped when the save
loads. Scavenger's Pack and Hauler's Pack disappear with everything in them.
So empty those first. In the shop, open Options, find Off the Books: Backpacks, switch
on "Before removing this mod: list what to move" and press Apply. A window lists every
backpack that still holds something, where it is and how many items to move (a stack
counts as one). It moves nothing itself. Move the items, then ask for the list again
until it says there is nothing left. "Cannot tell" means: look into that backpack
yourself.

WHEN SOMETHING SEEMS WRONG
Player.log shows a line starting with [Backpacks] when the mod meets a fault.

TRANSLATIONS
Translations are very welcome: every text is in Localization/en.csv. Send a translated
copy on GitHub: https://github.com/rnk-gaming/probably-stolen-mods/issues
